name: MyJellyFix — Netflix Skin
author: JocLRojas
description: Reskins the Jellyfin web UI to look like Netflix: dark background, red accent, custom font, card hover zoom. Client-only mod, no server changes.

vars.name: Accent Color
vars.description: Primary highlight color (buttons, links, selected tabs). Default is Netflix red.

vars.name: Background Color
vars.description: Main page background. Default is Netflix near-black.

vars.name: Card Radius (px)
vars.description: Border radius on media cards. Default 4px.

vars.name: Enable Hero Banner
vars.description: Use the first item's backdrop as a full-width hero at the top of the home page. Default off.
